neighbours.label: a treatment's effect or protection (effects, immunity, relief, results) where the text sets up how long it lasts or that it wears off
fire: The anesthetic numbs the gum quickly, but the effects fade within an hour.
Ice packs reduce swelling, though their effects are short-lived.
Researchers want to know how long the protection from the booster lasts.
Caffeine perks you up, but its effects wear off by mid-afternoon.
Steroid shots ease joint pain, but the relief usually lasts only weeks.
Scientists are unsure how long immunity after infection persists.
The sleeping pill works fast, but its effects don't last through the night.
Botox smooths wrinkles, but the results last only three to four months.
quiet: The anesthetic numbs the gum, and the effects include a tingling lip.
Ice packs reduce swelling, and their effects on bruising are well studied.
Researchers want to know whether the protection from the booster covers new variants.
Caffeine has well-known effects on heart rate and alertness.
Steroid shots ease joint pain, and patients report relief within days.
Scientists study how immunity after infection differs between children and adults.
The sleeping pill's side effects include dizziness and dry mouth.
Botox smooths wrinkles, and the results look natural in most patients.

notes: Card: 'their effects are temporary', 'the effects wear off', 'how long the immunity will last'; logit effect (- pole) promotes lasting/duration/temporary. Probe: 'but its effects are temporary' 0.86, 'side effects include' 0.03.
